intro.text: TypographyInter and Inconsolata are the primary Dask typefaces. Inter is best for for H-level titles and longform body copy. Inconsolata should be used when displaying syntax/code snippets or as a labeling device for charts, graphics, and specialty layout components.Download Typefaces
